text:
maria: Heads up — PTQ bring-up for the pairwise reranker (xlarge -> int8) shows ~-6% NDCG@10 on our dev holdout, but MRR@10 is basically unchanged. Rolling back for now. anyone seen this pattern?

alex: interesting — which holdout exactly? full dev or a particular slice? :eyes:
jia: can you paste a small failing example? curious if it's query or doc formatting.

maria: it's the 10k time-sampled dev (last 30d). biggest drops on queries with long docs (>2k tokens) and queries that include code blocks. quick failing example:
query: "how to optimize attention memory in LLMs?"
doc excerpt: "...```python
for k,v in cache.items():
    pass
```"

sam: two quick angles — (1) PTQ can subtly change tokenization boundaries if preprocessing differs, (2) quant can change margin scaling which hurts pairwise rankers. are we sure the preprocessing/pipeline is identical?
alex: can you run NDCG/MRR broken down by query length and doc-length bins? also compute top-1 agreement rate between fp16 and int8 (win-rate).
jia: PTQ sometimes affects the KV cache behavior too for long sequences — weird truncation interactions. also check whether the eval harness used `query_norm=v1` vs `v2` across runs.
maria: quick note — the bring-up PR inadvertently switched to query normalization v2 (strips punctuation differently). old model runs were on v1. re-running with v1 now. also re-checking truncation length and whether doc caching used stale fp16 embeddings.

maria: running slices and a bootstrap now; will paste results when done. asked eval-bot to kick off a bootstrap job for significance.

eval-bot: eval-runner: started bootstrap_ndcg job 2161234575 for model=rerank-int8-2026-03 baseline=rerank-fp16-2026-02 n=1000. ETA ~7m. link: https://ci.redwood/eval/2161234575

sam: if preprocessing mismatch is the culprit we should add a hard onboarding checklist item: "pin tokenization/normalization version and truncation policy" for every bring-up. also add slice-aware NDCG to the dashboard.
alex: also verify embedding caches — if you reused doc embeddings produced by fp16 model but reranker recomputes or expects quantized embeddings, mismatch kills ranking.

maria: results: bootstrap mean delta NDCG@10 = -0.043 (int8 - fp16), p≈0.08. Per-bin: long-docs (>2k tokens) delta = -0.12, normal docs delta = -0.01. Re-running with v1 preprocessing the overall delta shrinks to -0.01 (p≈0.32).
jia: nice — sounds like primary cause was the preprocessing drift plus a small residual quant effect on long docs. Next step: pin preprocessing in the onboarding flow and add a long-doc calibration step.
sam: for calibration try bias-correction, per-layer clipping, and longer calibration corpus that includes code snippets and long contexts. also run PTQ with a few different block sizes.
maria: I'll open a PR to update the onboarding checklist, add per-bin NDCG charts in the rerank dashboard, and run a targeted PTQ calibration sweep focused on long-doc cases. thanks all :tada:
